name: The Lord of the Rings Online: Quest Pack: Old Anórien
storyline:
Osgiliath Falls: The Enemy has captured Osgiliath, and their forces march toward Minas Tirith.
Siege of the White City: Trolls, Mumakil, and great beasts gather outside the city walls as Sauron’s armies prepare for an all-out assault.
Your Role:

Aid Gandalf and Pippin in defending the gates of Minas Tirith.
Rally Gondor’s defenders and prepare for the coming storm.
Experience the chaos and heroism of the Battle of Pelennor Fields, where the fate of Gondor hangs in the balance.

Epic Themes:
Courage, sacrifice, and the desperate struggle against overwhelming darkness dominate this chapter, setting the stage for Aragorn’s arrival and the final march toward Mordor.
summary:
The Old Anórien Quest Pack unlocks adventures in some of the most iconic locations of Gondor during the climactic moments of the War of the Ring. It is designed for characters level 100+ and includes:

Regions:

Pelennor Fields – the vast battlefield outside Minas Tirith.
Talath Anor – the sunlit plains leading to the White City.
Minas Tirith – the seven-tiered city under siege.

Epic Battle Content:
Participate in the Battle of Pelennor Fields, one of the most famous conflicts in Tolkien’s lore.
LOTRO Store Info:
This pack provides quests, deeds, and epic battle scenarios in Old Anórien.
